The '''Earthbound Staff''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Nulfastu, Earthbound]], a [[boss]] in [[Drakkar Lake]].

==Stats ==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Chaos damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Inspiration Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of [[Inspiration Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +60

== Skin ==
The skin is a different colored version of another unique staff, [[Magmus' Staff]].
